---
title: Freshers' taster sessions announced
date: 2026-09-20
summary: Never thrown a frisbee? Come to one of our three free taster sessions in welcome week.
---

New to the university, or new to ultimate? Our free taster sessions run three times in welcome week.
No experience or kit needed.

- **Monday** 6–8pm, main sports hall
- **Wednesday** 2–4pm, south field
- **Saturday** 11am–1pm, south field

Ultimate is a fast, non-contact team sport with no referees — players call their own fouls,
guided by the *Spirit of the Game*. It's one of the friendliest sports you can try.

Questions? Message us on any of our social channels.
